Author: Pankaj Purohit Bench: Manoj Kumar Tiwari, Pankaj Purohit  Office Notes,
 reports, orders SL. or proceedings

Date or directions COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS No  and Registrar's  order with  Signatures  WPCRL No.27 of 2024  Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Sharang Dhulia, learned counsel for petitioner.
2. Mr. R.K. Joshi, learned B.H. for the State.

3. Petitioner was convicted for the offence punishable under Sections 302/34, 376 and 201/34 IPC,
which resulted into his conviction and sentencing him for capital punishment.

In CRLA No.210 of 2004 filed by convict, a Co- ordinate Bench of this Court, by judgment dated 12.07.2005, upheld the conviction of petitioner-convict but modified his sentence of capital punishment to that of rigorous imprisonment.
4. At present, petitioner is lodged in District Jail, Haridwar.
By means of this petition, petitioner has prayed to direct the respondents to consider his release in accordance with law.

5. Learned counsel for petitioner submits that the total period of incarceration undergone by petitioner, without remission, is '20 years and 21 days' whereas it is '26 years, 4 months and 7 days'
with remission as on 31.12.2023.
Thus, learned counsel submits that petitioner is entitled for remission of sentence/premature release in terms of provisions contained in the Uttarakhand Jail Manual, 2023.

6. Learned counsel for petitioner further submits that petitioner has made representation(s) from time to time for his premature release but no decision, thereon, has been taken by the competent authority so far.
WPCRL/27/2024 on 14 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/164039737/
1
7. Learned State Counsel submits that let petitioner make a fresh representation which shall be decided expeditiously.
8. Accordingly, present writ petition is disposed of by permitting the petitioner to make a fresh representation seeking premature release within two weeks from today.

If petitioner makes representation within stipulated time, decision thereupon shall be taken by the Secretary, Home Department, Government of Uttarakhand within six weeks from the date of receipt of representation.
9. Pending application, if any, stands disposed of.

(Pankaj Purohit, J (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 14.06.2024 Rdang WPCRL/27/2024 on 14 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/164039737/
